The Warp Piston is a fallen piece of the Exodar that crash-landed on Bloodmyst Isle. This area was also the location of the Sun Gate used by the followers of Kael'thas Sunstrider to assault the draenei positions and retake the Exodar. The Sun Gate was later moved to an area south of the Vector Coil. The area now teems with many voidwalkers that have been created when the Sun Gate was used.

Warriors are melee fighters highly trained in the arts of weaponry. These mighty warriors, strong and quick on the battlefield, depend on their heavy plate armor, shields, and battle prowess to defend themselves and ensure enemies don’t focus on their softer-skinned allies. Weapon mastery is a staple of warrior training, and they are capable of delivering high damage with enormous two-handed weapons or by wielding two weapons. As warriors deal or take damage, their rage grows, allowing them to deliver truly crushing attacks in the heat of battle. Warriors are usually leading the charge into battle, tearing across the battlefield and using furious shouts and terrifying banners to rally their

The Warsong clan is a warlike orcish clan originally hailing from the plains of Nagrand. It was formerly led by the legendary Grommash "Grom" Hellscream, and later by his headstrong son, Garrosh Hellscream. The Warsong Outriders form the Horde forces in Ashenvale and Warsong Gulch, while the Warsong Offensive spearheaded the Horde Expedition's assault against the Scourge in Northrend.

Stances were a type of buff that warriors utilized. Each stance offered different bonuses, and allowed the warrior to fulfill specific combat roles. A warrior would choose which stance to be in at any time, and switching stances had a 1.5 second cooldown for all stances. However, switching stances did not trigger a global cooldown. Before patch 7.0.3 there were 3 available warrior stances: * Battle Stance (learned at level 1): An aggressive combat stance. Generates Rage from normal melee attacks. * Defensive Stance (learned at level 9): A tanking combat stance. Decreases damage taken by 20%. Significantly increases threat generation. Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat. * Gladiator

Warsong Lumber Mill is the Warsong Outriders base in Warsong Gulch. This lumber mill has three entrances. The main entrance is a long ramp located in the front of the base. Within the ramp are Boots of Speed (a special battleground item) that will grant you greatly increased run speed for several seconds. The other two entrances either take you straight into the flag room or onto a balcony that overlooks it. These entrances are closer to the flag, but they also take longer to reach and have no special items along the way. Attached to the ramp is a detour that leads to the top of the base. This path, while a great deal longer, is a good strategic point from which to view the entire flag room

in the Barrens.]] The Warsong Outriders are the Horde forces of the Warsong Gulch battleground. They are a faction of the Warsong clan, formerly led by Grom Hellscream, and are attempting to defend their logging operations in Ashenvale from the night-elven Silverwing Sentinels. Their base of operations, Mor'shan Base Camp, can be found at the northern end of the Northern Barrens.
A warrior set refers to a collection of equipment with a warrior class restriction that provides an additional bonus when worn together.

The Warsong Labor Camp is located in southeastern Ashenvale, east of Fallen Sky Lake and southwest of Dor'Danil Barrow Den. It is a small area containing loggers, harvesters, and orcish guards. It is occasionally attacked by Alliance adventurers since they can strike the guards without fear of retribution, due to the camp's relative isolation.

Warsong Hold is the headquarters of the Horde forces in Northrend. It is a great, spiky fortress that the Horde built for the Warsong Offensive, located in southern Borean Tundra, just a short distance from the Garrosh's Landing. Once led by Garrosh Hellscream during the war against the Lich King, he sent an army of peons to cut a quarry down into the tundra to make the walls and towers; which became the Mightstone Quarry surrounding the fortress. Along the road from Garrosh's Landing to Warsong Hold, a village including Torp's Farm sprang up to house the peons working on the fortress.
The Warsong Runner can be found in Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.

Warrior Training is the draenei warrior quest in which players are introduced to the training system. At the Crash Site in Ammen Vale on Azuremyst Isle, talk to Kore the warrior trainer. Just talking to him and agreeing to train completes this quest. Don't forget to train your first skills after you complete it.

This article lists the races that are able to become warriors, and the lore and speculation regarding each. Technically speaking, any race can become a warrior, it only takes effort and practice with melee weaponly after all.

The Warpwood Quarter is an area of Dire Maul East. It is located beyond the Broken Commons past the eastern instance portal, which does not require the Crescent Key to open. The area is so named for its numerous Warpwood ancients, but it also contains many lashers, as well as the annoying imp Pusillin, who will set off on a wild chase through the entire area, and eventually into the Hidden Reach. The Conservatory lies in the middle of the quarter, and dropping down from the edge is safe as long as there are no aggressive mobs at the bottom, and the jumper is at full health. After the Fourth War, the area is still teeming with demons and satyrs.

Warsong Hold Mages are blood elf Nerub'ar Victims rescued from the Mightstone Quarry in the Borean Tundra. Once rescued, they will attempt to help the player for a short time before returning to Warsong Hold. They provide the player with an intellect buff similar to a mage.

Warsong Hold Shaman are tauren Nerub'ar Victims rescued from the Mightstone Quarry in the Borean Tundra. Once rescued, they will attempt to help the player for a short time before returning to Warsong Hold. They heal the player and use frost shock on enemies.

Warpweaver Hashom is an ethereal transmogrifier located in the Canals of the Alliance capital of Stormwind. He is responsible for offering the service of transmogrification to those who desire a new look for their armor or weapons.

__NOTOC__ Warpstalker Hatchlings are warp stalkers located throughout the wooded parts of Terokkar Forest.
Warsong Commanders are orcs located by the Dark Portal in Tanaan Jungle.
Warspear Blood Guards are orcs found throughout the Road of Glory in Ashran. They may be seen escorting Warspear Raptor Riders.
Warspear Gladiators are Horde guards found throughout Warspear Outpost in Ashran.
The Warspear Keep is a sub-zone in Warspear Outpost in northern Ashran, . It holds the Horde generals in Ashran, as well as two class leaders and numerous guards.
Warpweaver Jasor is an ethereal found in Warspear's Tower of Elements in Ashran.
Warspear Grunts are orc guards found in Warspear of Ashran. Some of them are finally wearing their trademark helmets. Non-elite versions can be found patrolling the Road of Glory.
Warspear Shredders are shredders found at the goblin workshop in Warspear of Ashran.
Warspear Shadow Hunters are troll shadow hunters found in Warspear, Ashran. They can be seen patrolling around the troll area in the east of the zone, and guarding Shadow Hunter Gar'ant.
Warspear Lieutenants are orc guards found in Warspear of Ashran. They may be stationary or patrol the area on Worg mounts.
Warspear Prison Key can be used to unlock the cages of Horde Prisoners found in Warspear Outpost. See Ashran Prisoners.

The Warren Mother was a virmen that lived in the Valley of the Four Winds. After failing to buy carrots from Maraad, she and her group decided to try using different coins. Just above them, the dark shaman appeared and the Warren Mother tried to use the same tactic to get carrots. Unfortunately, they weren't friendly, and Zertin killed her on the spot.
Warspear Peons can be found in Warspear and Warspear Outpost, Ashran, doing construction and supply work. A sole peon at Warspear 41:53 acts as a repair vendor.

Warspear Centurions are guards which can be found in a few locations in Warspear Outpost, Ashran, such as guarding the entrance from Warspear itself, and escorting Genevere Hymnsorrow as she patrols the eastern entrance to the base.
Warspear Raptor Riders are summonable Horde NPCs found in Ashran's Road of Glory.

Warspear Hold is a sub-zone of Warspear, Ashran. Notably, it contains the faction quartermasters for the Arakkoa Outcasts, Steamwheedle Cartel and Frostwolf Orcs, a number of bankers and guild bankers, and the Honor Quartermaster for Ashran.
Warpweaver Tuviss is a ethereal transmogrifier located at Lunarfall's Storehouse in , as well as in the Simply Enchanting shop in Dalaran over the Broken Isles.
